the-forecast-in-your-chest.title: The Forecast in Your Chest
the-forecast-in-your-chest.description:
Anxiety can feel like breaking news — red banner, urgent music, something is wrong. But emerging science on constructed emotion suggests your body is sending weather data, not a final verdict. How the brain publishes a forecast, why excitement and dread run on the same instruments, and how to question the caption while respecting the signal.

The Reality Machine. New drops weekly.

#anxiety #psychology #consciousness #perception #neuroscience
